title: Archive through April 10, 2003 - Anonymous (Wednesday, February 19, 2003 - 08:34 pm)
content: It started with green and purple flashes in front of my eyes. I then experienced that I was sat up outside my body. I was aware that my body was still lying on my bed. There was a beautiful light, small at first but grew as it became closer. I felt a deep sense of peace, my thoughts were still as if nothing was important except this deep feeling of peace and beauty. A voice, that was unrecognizable to me, said, "You've gone too far. You've died." It was a beautiful voice, calm, soft, loving. I wasn't shocked at what the voice had said, I was still extremely peaceful. The voice said again, "You've gone too far you've died" then it said "Breathe, breathe you'll be all right." I was sat up outside my body but I could feel myself lying down trying to breathe. The next moment, it was like I sat up and caught myself inside myself. The light that I had been focused on faded outside the window and the darkness that had surrounded the light melted into the shadows of my bedroom. After taking the overdose, I had no serious illness and did not seek medical help. Physically my eyesight was improved, colours seemed brighter and detail was sharper. Other lights had colours around it like a spectrum, that hadn't been seen before and people sometimes had auras of colour around them as well. I felt for the first time ever a love and acceptance of myself and others that didn't exist before. I can't explain what ALL ONE is but I know that we are all one. I felt saddened after the experience because of the lack of respect people show to one another.

arrival.other_being_detail: An unrecognizable voice described as calm, soft, loving.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: The voice instructed: "Breathe, breathe you'll be all right."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Visual flashes (green and purple) at onset; darkness around the light; light faded outside the window as the experience ended.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Flashes → out-of-body awareness in bedroom → approaching/growing light → voice communication/instruction to breathe → return to body; no tunnel or life review described.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Felt "sat up outside my body" while also feeling the body lying down trying to breathe.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Improved eyesight and perception after the event: brighter colors, sharper detail, lights with spectrum-like colors, and sometimes seeing auras around people.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "You've gone too far. You've died." / "Breathe, breathe you'll be all right." / "I can't explain what ALL ONE is but I know that we are all one."
